name: dsh-se-skills
description: SE (Systems Engineer / Application Architect) workflow skills for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 16 skills covering Define → Design → Document → Verify → Validate, plus 6 /se-* entry commands and 5 review personas. Skills under ./skills are provider-served live; ./commands and ./agents are registered by the plugin (lib/index.js). Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add link:<this dir>` (see docs/dsh-setup.md).
